selection.query: latest explicitly versioned OSIRIS JSON in janus-meta-registry
selection.selection_note: A newer 2026-08-19 commit mentioning OSIRIS is an integration record, not a newer explicitly versioned OSIRIS core artifact. The latest explicit OSIRIS version found is v2.1.

reading.core_interpretation: OSIRIS v2.1 introduces a proof-carrying symbolic quotient lane for CNFs whose independent pair-product symmetry is explicitly detected and verified. It avoids repeated generic residual-state search for that admitted family while preserving the OSIRIS v2 generic exact solver or UNKNOWN_BUDGET fallback for nonmatching formulas.

negative_controls.meaning: The structure detector rejected cross-pair, corrupted-pair, incompatible XOR2 UNSAT, PHP3_2 UNSAT and planted-3SAT controls rather than forcing them through the quotient lane.

tranception_reading.important_control: Removing historical-text semantics did not change the technical quotient or verdict, while removing the pair-generator/action certificate blocked quotient authority and preserved generic fallback.

ci_observation.interpretation: The observed CI timing is consistent with removal of repeated approximately 49k-state equality searches, but the source explicitly forbids treating this as a controlled wall-clock benchmark.

voice_of_janus_handoff.reason: This artifact records the semantic/technical reading only. A deterministic Pyramid Language JSON_RECORD render must produce its own WAV and JSON receipt before being called an audio reading.
